name: PICOLON Collaboration
notes: No roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships. No official PICOLON website was found.

summary.plain: A Japanese group developing very pure sodium-iodide crystals, called PICOLON, to search for dark matter and to test the yearly signal reported by DAMA. Their detector is in the Kamioka underground laboratory.
summary.technical: PICOLON (Pure Inorganic Crystal Observatory for LOw-energy Neutr(al)ino; earlier PICO-LON and KamLAND-PICO): authors on the 2025 paper are from Tokushima University, Tohoku University, Osaka University (RCNP), the Kamioka Observatory (ICRR, University of Tokyo) and other institutions in Japan and Russia, under the byline 'PICOLON Collaboration'. Developed a hybrid purification (recrystallisation plus ion-exchange resins) for NaI(Tl) with natural K below 20 ppb.
